messages:
lia: Heads-up: prototype for rotating weight variants without restarts. Idea = content-addressed bundles + control-plane activation pointer.

sam: Sounds good. Need node validation + RCU swap to avoid restart.

tonY: Agree. Loader keeps active and candidate handles; swap in-memory once checksums & warmup probes pass.

lia: Warmup gating: require prefetch hit >= 0.6 OR probe suite pass, else fallback after TTL.

sam: Cache isolation: tag prefix cache entries with bundle hash so switches don't mix state.

tonY: Transcode at upload for common quant variants. Lazy transcode allowed but mark bundle "partial" until ready.

lia: Plan: manifest schema with layers + warmup block + fallback_hash. Tony to draft micro-RFC.

ops-bot: note added to runbook "model-rotation-hotplug".
